items.atmosphere: 0.1 MPa argon atmosphere at a flowing rate of 20 mL/min
items.quote: The DSC measurement of sample #4 was performed by Netzsch STA 449F3 simultaneous thermal analysis under a 0.1 MPa argon atmosphere at a flowing rate of 20 mL/min and a heating rate of 5 K/min.

items.instrument: automatic apparatus from Suzuki Shokan Co., Ltd. (Japan)
items.method: volumetric method according to Sievert's law
items.quote: After complete activation, pressure-compositiontemperature (PCT) plots of the LaNi5 alloy were measured at 303, 318, 333, and 347 K by a volumetric method according to Sievert's law using an automatic apparatus from Suzuki Shokan Co., Ltd. (Japan).

XRD measurement of alloys annealed at 623, 773, and 973 K (marked as samples #1, #2, and #3, respectively) was carried out on a DLMAX-2200 diffractometer (CuKa radiation, 101r2y r901, 41/min) operated at 40 kV and 40 mA.

High pressure differential scanning calorimetry (HP-DSC) for the hydrogen absorption/desorption of the LaNi5 alloy was performed on a Netzsch DSC 204 HP calorimeter under hydrogen atmosphere with 99.999% purity. LaNi5 powder samples were set in the apparatus, and measurements were made from room temperature to 423 K at constant pressures of 1 and 3 MPa, respectively. The temperature was then decreased to 313 K at a rate of 1 K/min.

items.instrument: Powder Diffraction Beamline, Australian Synchrotron, using a Mythen detector
items.quote: The alloy annealed at 1123 K for 50 d (marked as sample #4) was analyzed by high-resolution XRD (HR-XRD) on a Powder Diffraction Beamline, Australian Synchrotron, using a Mythen detector. The refined wavelength was 0.7279 Å with NIST LaB6.
LaNi5 purchased from Beijing General Research Institute for Non-Ferrous Metals was analyzed via XRD to confirm its phase composition.
The composition of the annealed alloy was identified to be La21.75Ni78.25 using Optima 7300 DV ICP.
The XRD measurement of LaNi5 was carried out after complete hydriding and dehydriding reactions, as shown in Fig. 7(a) and (b), respectively.

items.label: Casting ingots
items.quote: Casting ingots (70 g) were synthesized from high-purity La (99.99%) and Ni (99.999%) in stoichiometric amounts of La5Ni19 using a medium frequency induction furnace in a high-purity Ar (99.999%) atmosphere. The alloys were melted and flipped at least three times to promote complete mixing and melting.
